description: R-SORT-3 fixture r-sort-3c-accdb: DBEngine.CreateDatabase(path, dbLangGeneral, 128); table T(ID LONG primary key, K TEXT(255), G TEXT(32)) with 68 designed values by group (kana-prolonged, leading-modifier, expansion-accent, flags-positions, secondary-sum), inserted by AddNew/Update with exact code units; then CREATE INDEX IX_K ON T (K), a fresh build. The closed file is kept; the keys are read from it by CalcDb, not asked of ACE.
